scope: All ten mixes of Table 2 (kg/m3) with the fixed design ratios; 28-day compressive strength and elastic modulus (Table 3), tensile strength and ultimate tensile strain (Table 5), and the two flow values stated in the text. First-cracking strength, peak strain, strain energy and crack-pattern data are not transcribed.

materials.name: quartz sand
materials.detail: Quartz sand with a particle-size range of approximately 101–310 μm was used as the aggregate

materials.name: alkaline activator
materials.detail: The alkaline activator was prepared by mixing a 10 mol/L sodium hydroxide solution with a water glass solution in a mass ratio of 1:2.

materials.name: water glass solution
materials.detail: The inherent modulus of the water glass solution (the ratio of SiO2 to Na2O in moles) is 2.25, and the mass fractions of Na2O and SiO2 are 13.75% and 29.99% respectively.

materials.name: barium chloride
materials.detail: barium chloride (BaCl2) was incorporated as a retarder to regulate the setting time

materials.name: PE fibers
materials.detail: Ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE, hereafter PE) fibers with a length of 12 mm and a diameter of 24 μm

cures.text: Immediately after casting, all specimens were sealed with plastic film. After 24 h, they were demolded and transferred to a standard curing room maintained at 20 ± 2 °C and a relative humidity of at least 90%, where they were cured for 28 d prior to testing.

tests.method: ASTM C39/C39M-24; chord between 0.00005 strain and 40% of ultimate load
